description: Lane moves of human 7-key BMS charts (aggregate counts of the fitting half of the BMS Library mirror, no per-song data): for a single key note right after a single key note, how often each key 1-7 follows, by context 'previous key|move class into it|beat phase|density band'. Move classes: 0-12 a single key after a single key (step -6..+6, index = step + 6), 14 a single key after a chord, 16 at the start or after a rest (restMs). Phases: on a beat, 8th, 16th, other. Density bands: key notes per second within 2 s either side, below / from each edge. Read by generator/lanes.py (hands.laneMoves weighs the cost).
